annotations.title: Token flow: net buy and sell volume over time

description: Token flow of an ERC-20: DEX buy and sell volume, net flow, buy and sell counts, distinct buyers and sellers and the top-5 wallets' share of buying, in time buckets, from live Transfer logs on Base (default), Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism or Polygon. Use to see whether a token is being accumulated or dumped right now, and by how few wallets. Example: token=0x940181a94A35A4569E4529A3CDfB74e38FD98631. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

blocks.description: How many recent blocks to read, 100 to 10000 (default 1800: about 6 hours on Ethereum); on Base, which makes a block every 0.2 s, ten times that (default 18000, about an hour, up to 100000)

buckets.description: Time buckets to split the window into, 2 to 12 (default 6)

chain.description: base (default), ethereum, arbitrum, optimism or polygon

token.description: Token: 0x ERC-20 address, or a ticker such as AERO, DEGEN or USDC

name: token_flow
title: Token flow: net buy and sell volume over time
